protocol.buildMode: vite build (production bundle) served by vite preview; dev server never used
protocol.design: paired ?perf=1&perfCounters=1 present vs absent, both arms pinned to classifierMode=legacy-scan (the counters' kernel), 22 paired repetitions, arm order alternating per repetition, rep 0 cold (fresh context per arm), reps 1+ warm
protocol.wallMetric: in-page User Timing marks: last mi:stable-presented startTime minus mi:app-mount startTime (both marks are emitted unconditionally, so the metric exists in both arms without the diagnostic hook)
protocol.alwaysOnBudget: the recorder microbenchmark tests the ≤0.2 ms/frame budget and retention is measured directly; a separate instrumented-build vs recorder-free-build comparison is still required for the 2% end-to-end budget because the always-on ring is present in both arms here
protocol.optInBudget: paired median % difference with a BCa interval excluding worse-than-5% (plan §8)
protocol.retentionBudget: filled-ring snapshot JSON ≤64 KiB on the biggest case (plan §8)

bootstrap.method: paired bias-corrected accelerated (BCa) bootstrap of the median log(present/absent), B=10000 resamples
bootstrap.space: log-ratio; bounds reported as ratios (exp( bound )−1)

protocol.recorderCost: Node microbenchmark of the production ring (npm run bench:recorder), stored as recorder-cost-node.json; directional
protocol.hashByteOrder: SHA-256 over row-major RGBA bytes from getImageData(0, 0, width, height) of canvas.explorer__canvas
protocol.engineLabels: branded stable browser, headed with DevTools closed, on the declared target hardware (the machine running this harness)
protocol.executionMode: headed, branded stable browser on the session display
protocol.powerMode: AC, platform profile balanced (read from /sys at the end of the run)
